description: Purchase Order / Goods Receipt / Invoice matching for indirect procurement and logistics spend. Maps the PO lifecycle across three documents that must converge: PO Created → GR Posted → Invoice Received → Three-Way Match → Payment Released. Deviations (price variance, quantity shortfall, missing GR before invoice) are surfaced as conformance exceptions. Designed for ERP exports (SAP MM, Oracle Fusion, Coupa) but works with any flat extract that aligns on PO number.

required_tables.name: purchase_orders
required_tables.description: PO header (po_number, vendor_id, company_code, created_at, created_by, ordered_amount, currency, status)
required_tables.source_hint: SAP EKKO / Oracle PO_HEADERS / Coupa PO export

required_tables.name: goods_receipts
required_tables.description: Goods receipt / delivery confirmation (po_number, gr_number, received_at, received_qty, received_amount, posted_by)
required_tables.source_hint: SAP EKBE (VGABE=1) / Oracle RCV_TRANSACTIONS / 3PL receiving log

required_tables.name: invoices
required_tables.description: Supplier invoices (po_number, invoice_number, invoice_date, invoiced_amount, received_at_ap, matched_at, payment_date, match_status)
required_tables.source_hint: SAP RBKP / Oracle AP_INVOICES / Coupa invoice export

sample_kpis: Three-way match rate (% POs matched without exception)
P2P cycle time (PO Created to Payment Released)
notes: The critical control is that Goods Receipt Posted must appear before Invoice Received in each case — any trace where Invoice Received precedes Goods Receipt Posted is a three-way-match exception (potential fraud / control failure). Conformance deviations surface these automatically. For SAP: use EKBE (VGABE=1 for GR, VGABE=2 for IR) with BLDAT as the timestamp; the builder joins on EBELN. For price-variance exceptions, add invoiced_amount and ordered_amount as additional_columns and cross-reference in a custom KPI dashboard.
